objective: Keep the Search source registry singleton while resolving request and connection bound reindex sources lazily from the current scope.
selected_contracts: singleton registry stores ReindexSourceFactory instances only
registration discovery and scheduling never construct a source
every batch resolves a source immediately before readBatch
container scope reset yields a fresh source and connection graph
legacy static source registration remains compatible
factory and source provider mismatch fails closed
factory supplied exception reasons never cross persistence Audit or CLI boundaries
forbidden_behavior: resolve sources during package boot provider discovery or scheduling
cache a created source in singleton state
change Search database schema or migrations
claim production readiness or all packages readiness
required_tests: forged factory SearchReindexRejected persistence Audit and CLI regression
root Content integration scope reset canary
rollback_plan: restore the previous exact Search package revision in the root manifest and composer.lock
rerun Search quality gate and the root Content Search lifetime canary
